parameters.description: Unique identifier for the project.

description.description: The description of the Actual Production Quantity
description.example: Unable to complete installation due to weather

wbs_code_id.description: The Production Quantity Code for the Actual Production Quantity. This is necessary if your project is configured for Task Codes. DO NOT provide if your project is not configured for Task Codes.

cost_code_id.description: The Cost Code ID for the Actual Production Quantity. DO NOT provide if your project is configured for Task Codes.

crew_id.description: The Crew ID for the Actual Production Quantity

location_id.description: The Location ID for the Actual Production Quantity

timesheet_id.description: The Timesheet ID for the Actual Production Quantity. If the 'timesheet_id' is provided in the request, then the date for the timesheet will be associated with the production quantity, regardless of whether an additional date is sent in the request.

sub_job_id.description: The Sub Job ID for the Actual Production Quantity. DO NOT provide if your project is configured for Task Codes.

date.description: Date the Actual Production Quantity was installed. The date will be associated with the production quantity only when 'timesheet_id' is not included in the request.

prostore_file_ids.description: Prostore Files to attach to the Actual Production Quantity

upload_ids.description: The specified array of upload ids is saved as Actual Production Quantity attachments.

image_ids.description: Images to attach to the Actual Production Quantity

drawing_revision_ids.description: Drawing Revisions to attach to the Actual Production Quantity

file_version_ids.description: File Versions to attach to the Actual Production Quantity

form_ids.description: Forms to attach to the Actual Production Quantity

installed_step_quantities.description: Installed quantities keyed by production-tracking step. Required on create when the project uses rules of credit (at least one item). Optional on update; omit to leave existing steps unchanged. An empty array is treated as omitted on update and is rejected on create when rules of credit are on.

items.description: One production-tracking step quantity on an Actual Production Quantity write. On create, every item must include `step_id` and `quantity` and must not include `_destroy`. On update, each item is a delta: `{ step_id, quantity }` upserts that step, `{ step_id, _destroy: true }` removes it. Do not send both `quantity` and `_destroy` on the same item. Duplicate `step_id` values in one array are rejected.

step_id.description: Identifier of the production-tracking step this quantity applies to. Must be an integer. Whether the step belongs to the project is validated by Production Tracking, not this endpoint.

quantity.description: Installed quantity for this step. Numeric with at most two decimal places, from -999999999.99 to 999999999.99 inclusive. Zero and negatives are valid. Zero does not remove the step. Required on create. On update, omit or send null when `_destroy` is true.

_destroy.description: When true on an update, removes this `step_id` from the Actual Production Quantity. Update only; omit or send null on create. Mutually exclusive with `quantity`.

_destroy.description: When true on an update, removes this `step_id` from the Actual Production Quantity. Update only; omit or send null on create. Mutually exclusive with `quantity`.
